meta.title: Together In Adversity
meta.description: When you place your trust in your friends, you will never stand alone.

units.displayText: Null Area outside Zone G.

units.rawText: As the jellyfish momentarily hesitates, Sol descends from above, her blade ablaze, and cleanly splits it in two!
units.displayText: As the jellyfish momentarily hesitates, Sol descends from above, her blade ablaze, and cleanly splits it in two!

spans.text: As the jellyfish momentarily hesitates, Sol descends from above, her blade ablaze, and cleanly splits it in two!

units.rawText: Plap.
units.displayText: Plap.

spans.text: Plap.

units.rawText: Half of the jellyfish's body flops down to the ground, unmoving. Sol swiftly plants her foot on the remaining portion, which offers no resistance.
units.displayText: Half of the jellyfish's body flops down to the ground, unmoving. Sol swiftly plants her foot on the remaining portion, which offers no resistance.

spans.text: Half of the jellyfish's body flops down to the ground, unmoving. Sol swiftly plants her foot on the remaining portion, which offers no resistance.

units.rawText: That's it? Much easier than I thought...

spans.text: That's it? Much easier than I thought...

units.rawText: I can't find any trace of it... that should be that.
units.displayText: I can't find any trace of it... that should be that.

units.rawText: (squelching sounds)
units.displayText: (squelching sounds)

spans.text: (squelching sounds)

units.rawText: The nearby Entropics suddenly burst into a frenzy, their behavior originating from the jellyfish. The Entropic liquid on the ground blisters in unison, collectively flowing in a specific direction.
units.displayText: The nearby Entropics suddenly burst into a frenzy, their behavior originating from the jellyfish. The Entropic liquid on the ground blisters in unison, collectively flowing in a specific direction.

spans.text: The nearby Entropics suddenly burst into a frenzy, their behavior originating from the jellyfish. The Entropic liquid on the ground blisters in unison, collectively flowing in a specific direction.

units.rawText: Wha?!
units.displayText: Wha?!

spans.text: Wha?!

units.rawText: Amidst the chaos, the jellyfish lying at Sol's feet sinks into the liquid in an instant.
units.displayText: Amidst the chaos, the jellyfish lying at Sol's feet sinks into the liquid in an instant.

spans.text: Amidst the chaos, the jellyfish lying at Sol's feet sinks into the liquid in an instant.

units.rawText: (It's gone?! Has it escaped? Regardless, I need to protect—)
units.displayText: It's gone?! Has it escaped? Regardless, I need to protect—

spans.text: It's gone?! Has it escaped? Regardless, I need to protect—

units.rawText: Sol instinctively turns her gaze in Antonina's direction. Behind her, a somewhat distressed figure stands, and the shadow of a massive pillar of Entropic liquid envelops her.
units.displayText: Sol instinctively turns her gaze in Antonina's direction. Behind her, a somewhat distressed figure stands, and the shadow of a massive pillar of Entropic liquid envelops her.

spans.text: Sol instinctively turns her gaze in Antonina's direction. Behind her, a somewhat distressed figure stands, and the shadow of a massive pillar of Entropic liquid envelops her.

units.rawText: Anna, dodge!!
units.displayText: Anna, dodge!!

spans.text: Anna, dodge!!

units.rawText: Gah...!
units.displayText: Gah...!

spans.text: Gah...!

units.rawText:
Antonina tumbles to the side, narrowly avoiding the mass of liquid that resembles a living being.
In the meantime, Sol initiates her next move in the blink of an eye.
units.displayText:
Antonina tumbles to the side, narrowly avoiding the mass of liquid that resembles a living being.
In the meantime, Sol initiates her next move in the blink of an eye.

Antonina tumbles to the side, narrowly avoiding the mass of liquid that resembles a living being.

units.rawText: Sol rushes forward, shielding Antonina's body with her own as she lets her bomb fly—
units.displayText: Sol rushes forward, shielding Antonina's body with her own as she lets her bomb fly—

spans.text: Sol rushes forward, shielding Antonina's body with her own as she lets her bomb fly—

units.rawText: <size=40>BOOM!!</size>
units.displayText: BOOM!!

spans.text: BOOM!!

units.rawText: The explosive lands squarely in the middle of the swarm. As quickly as the nearby Entropics react, the sea of purple is briefly overcome by fire and light.
units.displayText: The explosive lands squarely in the middle of the swarm. As quickly as the nearby Entropics react, the sea of purple is briefly overcome by fire and light.

spans.text: The explosive lands squarely in the middle of the swarm. As quickly as the nearby Entropics react, the sea of purple is briefly overcome by fire and light.

units.rawText: <size=40>—There you are!</size>
units.displayText: —There you are!

spans.text: —There you are!

units.rawText: As Entropic liquid cascades through the air, the concealed jellyfish silhouette emerges.
units.displayText: As Entropic liquid cascades through the air, the concealed jellyfish silhouette emerges.

spans.text: As Entropic liquid cascades through the air, the concealed jellyfish silhouette emerges.

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: Sol's blade cleanly skewers the jellyfish, pinning it to the ground.
units.displayText: Sol's blade cleanly skewers the jellyfish, pinning it to the ground.

spans.text: Sol's blade cleanly skewers the jellyfish, pinning it to the ground.

units.rawText: Sol shields Antonina from harm as a shower of sparks and fluid rain down.
units.displayText: Sol shields Antonina from harm as a shower of sparks and fluid rain down.

spans.text: Sol shields Antonina from harm as a shower of sparks and fluid rain down.

units.rawText: Huff... you alright, Anna?
units.displayText: Huff... you alright, Anna?

spans.text: Huff... you alright, Anna?

units.rawText: Yeah... to detonate a bomb at this range, you must have lost your mind.
units.displayText: Yeah... to detonate a bomb at this range, you must have lost your mind.

spans.text: Yeah... to detonate a bomb at this range, you must have lost your mind.

units.rawText: Haha, so long as you're fine, Anna, that's all that matters.
units.displayText: Haha, so long as you're fine, Anna, that's all that matters.

spans.text: Haha, so long as you're fine, Anna, that's all that matters.

units.rawText: Whew... you're going to scare me to death one day.
units.displayText: Whew... you're going to scare me to death one day.

spans.text: Whew... you're going to scare me to death one day.

units.rawText: You know, I'm getting hit with a bit of déjà vu. Have I tackled you like this before?
units.displayText: You know, I'm getting hit with a bit of déjà vu. Have I tackled you like this before?

spans.text: You know, I'm getting hit with a bit of déjà vu. Have I tackled you like this before?

units.rawText: Actually, do Dolls get déjà vu in the...

spans.text: Actually, do Dolls get déjà vu in the...

units.rawText: Before she could finish her sentence, Sol collapses onto Antonina in a heap.
units.displayText: Before she could finish her sentence, Sol collapses onto Antonina in a heap.

spans.text: Before she could finish her sentence, Sol collapses onto Antonina in a heap.

units.rawText: Sol?!
units.displayText: Sol?!

spans.text: Sol?!

units.rawText: Antonina gets to her feet in a hurry and immediately begins to diagnose Sol's current state.
units.displayText: Antonina gets to her feet in a hurry and immediately begins to diagnose Sol's current state.

spans.text: Antonina gets to her feet in a hurry and immediately begins to diagnose Sol's current state.

units.rawText: Phew... thank goodness it's just unconsciousness caused by neural overload...
units.displayText: Phew... thank goodness it's just unconsciousness caused by neural overload...

spans.text: Phew... thank goodness it's just unconsciousness caused by neural overload...

units.rawText: Did she take the scaring-to-death thing seriously?
units.displayText: Did she take the scaring-to-death thing seriously?

spans.text: Did she take the scaring-to-death thing seriously?

units.rawText: Letting out a long sigh of relief, Antonina tugs at Sol's hair with a certain degree of indignation.
units.displayText: Letting out a long sigh of relief, Antonina tugs at Sol's hair with a certain degree of indignation.

spans.text: Letting out a long sigh of relief, Antonina tugs at Sol's hair with a certain degree of indignation.

units.rawText: An anxious voice comes through Antonina's terminal. She turns around to find her squad members rushing towards the two of them.
units.displayText: An anxious voice comes through Antonina's terminal. She turns around to find her squad members rushing towards the two of them.

spans.text: An anxious voice comes through Antonina's terminal. She turns around to find her squad members rushing towards the two of them.

units.rawText: Captain Sol!!
units.displayText: Captain Sol!!

spans.text: Captain Sol!!

units.rawText: She should be fine. The jellyfish has been confirmed eliminated. Keep a good eye on her; we're going to join up with Magnhilda's team.
units.displayText: She should be fine. The jellyfish has been confirmed eliminated. Keep a good eye on her; we're going to join up with Magnhilda's team.

spans.text: She should be fine. The jellyfish has been confirmed eliminated. Keep a good eye on her; we're going to join up with Magnhilda's team.

units.rawText: Understood!
units.displayText: Understood!

spans.text: Understood!

units.rawText: Antonina props Sol up, turning towards the other end of this sea of Entropics.
units.displayText: Antonina props Sol up, turning towards the other end of this sea of Entropics.

spans.text: Antonina props Sol up, turning towards the other end of this sea of Entropics.

units.rawText: The Oasis would not be far.
units.displayText: The Oasis would not be far.

spans.text: The Oasis would not be far.

units.rawText: The Oasis, in front of Zone G's Sandbox Barrier.
units.displayText: The Oasis, in front of Zone G's Sandbox Barrier.

spans.text: The Oasis, in front of Zone G's Sandbox Barrier.

units.rawText: (Sounds of gunfire)
units.displayText: (Sounds of gunfire)

spans.text: (Sounds of gunfire)

units.rawText: The fires of conflict on the other end of the Entropic horde illuminate the breach in the Sandbox Barrier. The defending agents charge into the fray, fighting off stream after stream of Entropic mass.
units.displayText: The fires of conflict on the other end of the Entropic horde illuminate the breach in the Sandbox Barrier. The defending agents charge into the fray, fighting off stream after stream of Entropic mass.

spans.text: The fires of conflict on the other end of the Entropic horde illuminate the breach in the Sandbox Barrier. The defending agents charge into the fray, fighting off stream after stream of Entropic mass.

units.rawText: Horizon! Didn't you say there'd be reinforcements? Where are they?
units.displayText: Horizon! Didn't you say there'd be reinforcements? Where are they?

spans.text: Horizon! Didn't you say there'd be reinforcements? Where are they?

units.rawText: There was an explosion over where Sol was. We can't make contact currently.
units.displayText: There was an explosion over where Sol was. We can't make contact currently.

spans.text: There was an explosion over where Sol was. We can't make contact currently.

units.rawText: B-but our operands are already... (whimpers)
units.displayText: B-but our operands are already... (whimpers)

spans.text: B-but our operands are already... (whimpers)

units.rawText: Don't worry. I have some reserves here. However, they may only last us a precious few minutes.
units.displayText: Don't worry. I have some reserves here. However, they may only last us a precious few minutes.

spans.text: Don't worry. I have some reserves here. However, they may only last us a precious few minutes.

units.rawText: ...Hahahahahahaha!
units.displayText: ...Hahahahahahaha!

spans.text: ...Hahahahahahaha!

units.rawText: Uwah! C-Captain Magnhilda? Is she being affected by neural data disorder? Do I need to call a med-

units.rawText: Mai, it is in these circumstances where one's blood truly boils!
units.displayText: Mai, it is in these circumstances where one's blood truly boils!

spans.text: Mai, it is in these circumstances where one's blood truly boils!

units.rawText: B-blood boils?
units.displayText: B-blood boils?

spans.text: B-blood boils?

units.rawText: Magnhilda leads a squad in the field, sending an airborne Entropic flying with a swift hook.
units.displayText: Magnhilda leads a squad in the field, sending an airborne Entropic flying with a swift hook.

spans.text: Magnhilda leads a squad in the field, sending an airborne Entropic flying with a swift hook.

units.rawText: Aha, how's that line go again? "Only by skirting death does one truly live"?
units.displayText: Aha, how's that line go again? "Only by skirting death does one truly live"?

spans.text: Aha, how's that line go again? "Only by skirting death does one truly live"?

units.rawText: That feeling of flesh against flesh... that's how a real fight should feel!
units.displayText: That feeling of flesh against flesh... that's how a real fight should feel!

spans.text: That feeling of flesh against flesh... that's how a real fight should feel!

units.displayText: Hahahahahaha...

ha
ha
ha
ha
ha...

units.rawText: I... I've got some more in me, too!
units.displayText: I... I've got some more in me, too!

spans.text: I... I've got some more in me, too!

units.rawText: Mai grits her teeth, wielding her meteorological monitoring pole once more. Soon, a small storm began to rage amidst the Entropic horde.
units.displayText: Mai grits her teeth, wielding her meteorological monitoring pole once more. Soon, a small storm began to rage amidst the Entropic horde.

spans.text: Mai grits her teeth, wielding her meteorological monitoring pole once more. Soon, a small storm began to rage amidst the Entropic horde.

units.rawText: Ohhhh! That's it, Mai! That's the spirit!
units.displayText: Ohhhh! That's it, Mai! That's the spirit!

spans.text: Ohhhh! That's it, Mai! That's the spirit!

units.rawText: Squad M02, use this chance! Attack!
units.displayText: Squad M02, use this chance! Attack!

spans.text: Squad M02, use this chance! Attack!

units.rawText: Whew... even I...
units.displayText: Whew... even I...

spans.text: Whew... even I...

units.rawText: Look out!
units.displayText: Look out!

spans.text: Look out!

units.rawText: Uwah!
units.displayText: Uwah!

spans.text: Uwah!

units.rawText: Horizon swats away an Entropic making an attempt on Mai.
units.displayText: Horizon swats away an Entropic making an attempt on Mai.

spans.text: Horizon swats away an Entropic making an attempt on Mai.

units.rawText: Not a moment of respite on the battlefield, huh...
units.displayText: Not a moment of respite on the battlefield, huh...

spans.text: Not a moment of respite on the battlefield, huh...

units.rawText: Horizon's posture trembles. She collapses, crumpling to the ground.
units.displayText: Horizon's posture trembles. She collapses, crumpling to the ground.

spans.text: Horizon's posture trembles. She collapses, crumpling to the ground.

units.rawText: Captain Horizon! Y-your body's so cold, what's going on...
units.displayText: Captain Horizon! Y-your body's so cold, what's going on...

spans.text: Captain Horizon! Y-your body's so cold, what's going on...

units.rawText: I-I'll give you some of my operands...
units.displayText: I-I'll give you some of my operands...

spans.text: I-I'll give you some of my operands...

units.rawText: No need. Everyone is... doing everything in their power.
units.displayText: No need. Everyone is... doing everything in their power.

spans.text: No need. Everyone is... doing everything in their power.

units.rawText: Horizon glances at Magnhilda, still in the melee at the very front line. Even adrenaline and bloodlust hardly mask the fatigue inflicted by battle.
units.displayText: Horizon glances at Magnhilda, still in the melee at the very front line. Even adrenaline and bloodlust hardly mask the fatigue inflicted by battle.

spans.text: Horizon glances at Magnhilda, still in the melee at the very front line. Even adrenaline and bloodlust hardly mask the fatigue inflicted by battle.

units.rawText: It's a shame we didn't get to reboot the barrier. I hope Antonina won't blame me...
units.displayText: It's a shame we didn't get to reboot the barrier. I hope Antonina won't blame me...

spans.text: It's a shame we didn't get to reboot the barrier. I hope Antonina won't blame me...

units.rawText: No way! You've already done fantastic, Captain Horizon. Just a little longer...
units.displayText: No way! You've already done fantastic, Captain Horizon. Just a little longer...

spans.text: No way! You've already done fantastic, Captain Horizon. Just a little longer...

units.rawText: I'll stand till my last breath. The Oasis is behind us, after all. There are so many designs of mine here. How could I ever let them...
units.displayText: I'll stand till my last breath. The Oasis is behind us, after all. There are so many designs of mine here. How could I ever let them...

spans.text: I'll stand till my last breath. The Oasis is behind us, after all. There are so many designs of mine here. How could I ever let them...

units.rawText: Sniff... Captain Horizon!
units.displayText: Sniff... Captain Horizon!

spans.text: Sniff... Captain Horizon!

units.rawText: A stream of operands flows into Horizon through Mai's hands.
units.displayText: A stream of operands flows into Horizon through Mai's hands.

spans.text: A stream of operands flows into Horizon through Mai's hands.

units.rawText: Before I made it to the Oasis, I was scared. There were Sanctifiers everywhere.
units.displayText: Before I made it to the Oasis, I was scared. There were Sanctifiers everywhere.

spans.text: Before I made it to the Oasis, I was scared. There were Sanctifiers everywhere.

units.rawText: But luckily, Persicaria brought me back here. I got to know everyone and could make all the balloons I wanted. I was so truly happy...
units.displayText: But luckily, Persicaria brought me back here. I got to know everyone and could make all the balloons I wanted. I was so truly happy...

spans.text: But luckily, Persicaria brought me back here. I got to know everyone and could make all the balloons I wanted. I was so truly happy...

units.rawText: Mai...
units.displayText: Mai...

spans.text: Mai...

units.rawText: And... the most important thing! I've always thought Magnhilda was super cool, and I wanted to be as brave as she was!
units.displayText: And... the most important thing! I've always thought Magnhilda was super cool, and I wanted to be as brave as she was!

spans.text: And... the most important thing! I've always thought Magnhilda was super cool, and I wanted to be as brave as she was!

units.rawText: I never would have imagined in my wildest dreams that I'd be on the frontline with everyone!
units.displayText: I never would have imagined in my wildest dreams that I'd be on the frontline with everyone!

spans.text: I never would have imagined in my wildest dreams that I'd be on the frontline with everyone!

units.rawText: Hehe, you've already been cool enough today!
units.displayText: Hehe, you've already been cool enough today!

spans.text: Hehe, you've already been cool enough today!

units.rawText: Horizon caresses Mai's head a little. With some more operands in her system, Horizon climbs to her feet again.
units.displayText: Horizon caresses Mai's head a little. With some more operands in her system, Horizon climbs to her feet again.

spans.text: Horizon caresses Mai's head a little. With some more operands in her system, Horizon climbs to her feet again.

units.rawText: Thank you, Mai. Will you be alright?
units.displayText: Thank you, Mai. Will you be alright?

spans.text: Thank you, Mai. Will you be alright?

units.rawText: Ahh... yeah! I can make maybe another one or two of those storms...
units.displayText: Ahh... yeah! I can make maybe another one or two of those storms...

spans.text: Ahh... yeah! I can make maybe another one or two of those storms...

units.rawText: Then we'll stand together here until the end!
units.displayText: Then we'll stand together here until the end!

spans.text: Then we'll stand together here until the end!

units.rawText: Horizon and Mai raise their weapons anew. At this moment, Antonina's voice came from a place perhaps not so far away.
units.displayText: Horizon and Mai raise their weapons anew. At this moment, Antonina's voice came from a place perhaps not so far away.

spans.text: Horizon and Mai raise their weapons anew. At this moment, Antonina's voice came from a place perhaps not so far away.

units.rawText: <size=40>Combat personnel, coordinate attacks with Squad Magnhilda! Medical and logistics personnel, reinforce the barrier with me!</size>
units.displayText: Combat personnel, coordinate attacks with Squad Magnhilda! Medical and logistics personnel, reinforce the barrier with me!

spans.text: Combat personnel, coordinate attacks with Squad Magnhilda! Medical and logistics personnel, reinforce the barrier with me!

units.rawText: They're here!
units.displayText: They're here!

spans.text: They're here!

units.rawText: The reinforcements are here, thank goodness...
units.displayText: The reinforcements are here, thank goodness...

spans.text: The reinforcements are here, thank goodness...

units.rawText: Uu—<size=60>waaahhh!</size>
units.displayText: Uu—waaahhh!

spans.text: Uu—
waaahhh!

units.rawText: Mai wails, letting all of her emotions out.
units.displayText: Mai wails, letting all of her emotions out.

spans.text: Mai wails, letting all of her emotions out.

units.rawText: Uwah... I really thought I'd never get to make any more balloons...
units.displayText: Uwah... I really thought I'd never get to make any more balloons...

spans.text: Uwah... I really thought I'd never get to make any more balloons...

units.rawText: You really do like balloons...
units.displayText: You really do like balloons...

spans.text: You really do like balloons...

units.rawText: Though this really will be the last charge.
units.displayText: Though this really will be the last charge.

spans.text: Though this really will be the last charge.

units.displayText: The pair look into the distance.
